question: How do nuisance reoptimization and central-volume knowledge affect within-bound profile geometry for evoked gain and removal rates in the existing synthetic model?

model.unchanged: BC012 model, 24 states, equilibrium reconditioning with exact basal G/I and known SC input, 30g gastric load, 240min, fixed hepatic/action/meal/Cp exchange and equimolar appearance

observation.source: Fresh unchanged BC012/BC011 generator at volume1; known development examples, not held-out evaluation
observation.conditioning: Exclude t0 G/I from stochastic residuals; t0 Cp remains observed. 25 GIC or16 GI residuals. Independent Gaussian errors with fixed declared SD for noisy examples; noiseless gives weighted-objective geometry, not coverage.

inference.profile_starts: Two starts at each target: unrestricted best parameters and whichever of the two inherited off-truth starts is farthest in nuisance log coordinates from that best (tie picks first). Fixed/interest coordinates override starts. No sequential warm-start selection.
inference.objective: Q=sum(((prediction-observation)/fixed_SD)^2)=2*least_squares.cost. DeltaQ subtracts the same-design/data/solver unrestricted minimum; never clip negative DeltaQ.
inference.volume_projection: If V is free nuisance, minimize analytically over a=1/V: a=clip(sum(q*y)/sum(q*q),1/1.5,1/0.5), V=1/a, q=Cp(theta_first3,V1); Cp t0 included. Other nuisance parameters fitted in log coordinates. Keep projected volume estimate and bounds visible. When V is interest or fixed, do not project.
inference.baseline_comparator: For each free-volume dataset, independently run unchanged BC012 unprojected two-start fit_case under fit solver; compare best objective to projected unrestricted fit. Parent exact t0 G/I residuals contribute only floating roundoff.

profiles.cutoff_meaning: Nominal asymptotic pointwise one-parameter chi-square(1)95% reference contour under declared Gaussian SDs; not joint coverage, finite-sample/human confidence or coverage with active boundaries.
profiles.refinement: Retain coarse/fine sampled topology. Bisect EVERY adjacent sampled sign-change bracket of DeltaQ-cutoff; retain complete history until absolute multiplier bracket width <=0.005 (max12 bisections). Report all crossing brackets and intervals supported by sampled points, never infer untested absence of disconnected regions.
profiles.slice: At each target also evaluate Q with ALL nuisance values held at unrestricted best, including volume. This is a fixed-nuisance slice comparator, not the profile.
profiles.solver_verification: Refit unrestricted baseline under reference solver with same3starts. Refit both final endpoints of EVERY crossing and both physical bounds under reference solver with two fixed profile starts; also evaluate each fit-solver best parameter vector under reference solver. Require objective agreement and contour-side agreement at checked endpoints/bounds.
profiles.bounds: Interest bounds and active nuisance bounds are engineering limits; classify bound-limited endpoints and annotate nuisance-bound hits. Do not extrapolate or force closed intervals.

verification: Run unchanged BC012 forward verification; independent quadratic profiling oracle, conditional volume minimizer and bound oracles before biological profiling; verify same shared observations and profile/slice arithmetic; reference solver refits, baseline comparator and full fresh-process repetition.
failure_policy: Store every start, fixed value, projected volume, predictions, residuals, nuisance bounds and failures. Any optimizer/model failure, missing planned case/profile/point, profile below declared minimum, profile above feasible slice, failed independent/numerical gate or unresolved reference contour-side mismatch prevents accepted completion. Never hide a lower profile by clipping DeltaQ or silently replace the original baseline. Preserve failed archives and require documented amendment before changing protocol.
excluded: human data or independent empirical validation
new noise realizations or coverage simulation
global uniqueness or proof no hidden profile components
claims of finite-sample/human confidence or therapy effect

sources.use: weighted objective, likelihood-ratio contour, nuisance reoptimization and local-minimum caution

sources.location: SelfLiang1987 section3 pp607-609 and section4 p610
sources.use: regularity and parameter-boundary limitations of chi-square reference
